cat > programs/task-784da04f.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    full=[r for r in grid if len(set(r))==1]
    if not full: return out
    color=full[0][0]
    for i,r in enumerate(grid):
        if all(x==color for x in r): out[i]=[2]*w
    # The separator color marks a noisy vertical divider; recolor its strongest column.
    c=max(range(w), key=lambda j: sum(grid[i][j]==color for i in range(h)))
    for i in range(h): out[i][c]=2
    return out
PY
